# ShortcutSheet

The single keyboard-shortcut help surface, opened with ?, listing every shortcut by where it works, as key-cap tables.

`SongNodes.ShortcutSheet` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ShortcutSheet open onClose={…} groups={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ShortcutSheet" open="{{yes}}" on-close="{{…}}" groups="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ShortcutSheetProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` * | `boolean` | Open state (? opens it outside text fields). |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` | Called on Esc, close button or scrim click; focus returns to the opener. |
| `groups` * | `{ title: string; scope: string; rows: { keys: string; action: string }[] }[]` | Tables by scope; keys use "+" for combos, "\|" for alternatives and " then " for sequences. |
| `removed` | `{ keys: string; note: string }[]` | Shortcuts removed because they clashed, shown as a note. |
